passages.text:
Hi Mileydi,
I just wanted to close the loop on this and let you know that we checked and DRG Bureau colleagues have not followed
up with Meta on the Trusted Partners Network (TPP), largely because of GC guidance with regards to our relationship
with social media companies. As the agency's Chief Digital Democracy Officer, Vera is currently not comfortable pushing
them further on the TPP.
GC has reminded us of FAQ #16 of the GC guidance which mentions that we cannot be perceived to be
putting pressure on them to change policies and as such, repeated questions about the same program may be viewed as
Given this, it does not appear that we have the room to engage with Meta on TPP at this time, despite legitimate concerns
about under-resourcing, under-staffing, and response times, among others.
If you would want to get back to them, you could say that we have discussed and have nothing further to add at this time.
Just let us know if you need anything else on this front. Thanks!
Best,
Daniella

On Wed, Apr 24, 2024 at 2:42 PM Daniella Burgi-Palomino <[contact omitted]> wrote:
Hi Mileydi,
We are currently reaching out to colleagues in the DRG Bureau to follow-up on the Trusted Partners Program (TPP) to
see whether there has been any following since a call they organized in August 2023 with Internews on a report with
recommendations and critiques of the TPP. We think it's important to get a sense of who has tracked this internally first
given the Internews report recommendations before we go back to Meta to see how they've responded to these critiques
or even if we recommend civil society organizations. Meta's response to Cara's question about how they're responding to
the Internews report critiques in the meeting we had with them were a bit unsatisfactory so when we have more
information, we'd like to have a longer conversation with them.
At this point, we suggest you thank them for sharing this information and mention that we will discuss internally and get
back to them. You can feel free to loop in Cara and I to the email response and we will follow-up from there. Thanks!
